samples.title: Điện thoại trong lớp
samples.prompt: Write to Ms Brown at a local centre to ask about a digital learning workshop. Explain your interest, ask about arrangements and costs, and ask how to register.
requirementsVi: Nêu mục đích và nhu cầu.
Hỏi giờ, điều kiện, chi phí.
Hỏi cách đăng ký.
samples.summaryVi: Điện thoại có ích khi có nhiệm vụ rõ; thông báo và luật dùng không rõ dễ gây xao nhãng.

paragraphs.label: Mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to ask for further information about a digital learning workshop. I saw the notice at the community centre and would like to know whether the session would be suitable for someone with limited experience.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chào người biết tên và nêu mục đích.

paragraphs.label: Nhu cầu
paragraphs.text: I am interested in smartphones in the classroom because students can quickly access useful learning material. For example, a class can compare two digital maps to explain how a neighbourhood has changed. I would like a practical introduction rather than a session that requires specialist knowledge.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích hoàn cảnh để người nhận tư vấn đúng.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi
paragraphs.text: Could you please confirm whether the session is on Saturday at nine in the morning and how long it lasts? I would also like to know the fee and whether materials are included. The notice mentions that participants will try a phone-based research task and discuss classroom rules; should I bring a charged phone or any other equipment?
paragraphs.noteVi: Câu hỏi gián tiếp về sắp xếp và chuẩn bị.

paragraphs.label: Đăng ký và kết
paragraphs.text:
Finally, could you explain how to register and whether there is a deadline? If places are limited, please let me know when I should apply.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter. Please let me know if you need any further information. I look forward to your reply.

Yours sincerely,
Minh Nguyen
paragraphs.noteVi: Hỏi bước tiếp, cảm ơn và kết thư trang trọng.
